arguments.query:
WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE pid = 2168
    AND process_guid = '{558F98EB-5257-62D7-7501-000000003C00}'
    AND time BETWEEN '2022-07-20 00:54:47' AND '2022-07-20 00:58:30'
    AND COALESCE(raw_event_type,'') NOT IN ('process_create','ACTION_CREATE_PROCESS')
    AND (
      (filemod_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(filemod_name) <> '')
      OR (regmod_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(regmod_name) <> '')
    )
    AND (
      lower(COALESCE(access,'')) LIKE '%create%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(access,'')) LIKE '%write%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(access,'')) LIKE '%mod%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(access,'')) LIKE '%delete%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(access,'')) LIKE '%set%'
      OR lower(COALESCE(access,'')) LIKE '%rename%'
    )
), reps AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY COALESCE(object,''), COALESCE(access,''), COALESCE(filemod_name,''), COALESCE(regmod_name,'')
    ORDER BY time, event_record_id, source_row_id
  ) AS rn
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT time, pid, pname, process_name, access, object, source_stream, event_record_id, event_id, source_row_id, command_line, filemod_name, regmod_name, process_guid, parent_process_guid, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line
FROM reps
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY time, event_record_id, source_row_id
LIMIT 30;

SELECT COALESCE(raw_event_type,'') AS raw_event_type,
       COALESCE(access,'') AS access,
       CASE WHEN filemod_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(filemod_name) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_filemod_name,
       CASE WHEN regmod_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(regmod_name) <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_regmod_name,
       COUNT(*) AS rows,
       MIN(time) AS first_time,
       MAX(time) AS last_time,
       MIN(event_record_id) AS min_event_record_id,
       MAX(event_record_id) AS max_event_record_id
FROM audit_logs
WHERE pid = 2168
  AND process_guid = '{558F98EB-5257-62D7-7501-000000003C00}'
  AND time BETWEEN '2022-07-20 00:54:47' AND '2022-07-20 00:58:30'
GROUP BY COALESCE(raw_event_type,''), COALESCE(access,''), has_filemod_name, has_regmod_name
ORDER BY first_time, raw_event_type, access
LIMIT 30;
